newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GRINAKER SAYS AVI TO SELL STAKE.
newsitem.headline: GRINAKER SAYS AVI TO SELL STAKE.

text.p: South Africa's Grinaker Holdings Ltd said on Friday that a merger between electronic firms Persetel Holdings Ltd and Q-Data Holdings Ltd would see the firm's shareholder structure change.
Grinaker said Anglovaal Industries was now in talks to sell its stake in Grinaker to Kunene Brothers and key Grinaker management.
The move will see Kunene Brothers and management each hold less than 35 percent of Grinaker shares. "There is no concert part relationship between the two parties," the firm said.
Grinaker said the Securites and Regulation Panel had said that the deal did not mean any offer had to be made to Grinaker minority shareholders.
It added that shareholders should continue to exercise caution when trading in Grinaker shares as another announcement is due to be published.
The statement also said Grinaker, Grintek Ltd and Siltek Ltd would unbundle the Persetel shares they are set to receive in the wake of Q-Data's unbundling in the merger.
On Thursday information technology companies Persetel and Q-Data said they had agreed to merge their operations to form a company with an expected market capitalisation of 12 billion rand.
